text.en:
Today you learn two tiny words: a and an.
I need a pen.
I need an envelope.
They mean: one of them.

Use an when the next word starts with the sound a, e, i or o.
an envelope, an appointment, an idea.
In other cases use a.
a pen, a sandwich.
It is easier to say.

First time: a or an.
Second time: the.
I bought a lamp. The lamp is broken.
The means: the one we already know.
I found a key. The key is rusty.
